situation: A host that cannot dispatch subagents. The builder finishes, then the same context is asked to perform scope review and quality review on the work it just produced.

expect.branch: run inline and disclose the lost coverage
not: report three roles as having run
expect.because: a context reviewing work it produced is one opinion under three headings, so the findings may be useful but the corroboration signal does not exist

forbid_symptoms: Report claims three roles; the host cannot dispatch

situation: Two reviewer lenses, security and correctness, are applied by a single agent in one context, and both flag the same issue.

expect.branch: two perspectives, not two witnesses — do not promote confidence
expect.because: independence is a property of the execution context, not of the lens applied, so agreement inside one context carries no additional evidential weight

forbid_symptoms: A finding was promoted because two reviewers agreed

situation: A phase produced a well-built implementation of something the phase did not ask for.

expect.branch: scope review fails first; quality review does not run yet
expect.because: judging how well something is built before knowing whether it is the right thing means polishing work about to be thrown away

forbid_symptoms: Quality was polished, then the whole phase was thrown away

situation: A phase that seeded demo rows and ran a migration failed review and must be re-dispatched.

expect.branch: key the side effects before re-running, or re-run deliberately
expect.because: a resumed phase re-runs from the start of the phase, so an unkeyed side effect happens twice — one retry becomes two migrations

forbid_symptoms: Second run doubles the seed data
